name: Sahrawi Arab Democratic Republic
native: الجمهورية العربية الصحراوية الديمقراطية (al-Jumhūriyya al-ʿArabiyya aṣ-Ṣaḥrāwiyya ad-Dīmuqrāṭiyya)

predecessors.name: Kingdom of Spain
predecessors.text: all of Western Sahara, the 266,000 km2 the republic claims

ledger.x: 1976: Mauritania takes the south of Western Sahara.
1976 (27 February): the Sahrawi Arab Democratic Republic is proclaimed at Bir Lehlou.
1976: the Polisario war against Morocco, begun on 31 October 1975, continues under the new republic.
1979 (5 August): Mauritania makes peace with the Polisario.
1979 (5 August): Mauritania leaves its share under the peace treaty of 5 August 1979.
2008 (27 February): the provisional capital moves from Bir Lehlou to Tifariti ('formally moved to Tifariti' on 27 February 2008).

wars.name: Western Sahara War
wars.outcome: Stalemate: Mauritania made peace on 5 August 1979 and Morocco annexed its share on 11 August 1979; Morocco built a berm from the mid-1980s and controls about 80%, the Polisario about 20%, after the ceasefire of 6 September 1991.

wars.name: Western Sahara conflict (2020 renewal)
wars.outcome: Fighting resumed after the Guerguerat incident of 13 November 2020 ended the 29-year ceasefire; the pages opened give no change of control and no events for 2023-2024.

certainty.note: No agreed boundary: the Berm is a military line, the 1991 ceasefire line is the Berm, and Morocco and the Polisario each claim the whole territory.
